ov: Limbless reptiles with more than 4,170 species, found on every continent except Antarctica. Flexible jaws let them swallow prey much larger than their own heads.

why.dg: Most snakes aren’t venomous, but snakebites kill an estimated 100,000 people a year, according to the WHO.
why.h: In cold winters snakes brumate, a dormancy like hibernation, except that they stay awake but inactive.
why.p: Docile species such as the ball python and corn snake are kept as pets, mostly captive-bred.
why.et: Some are: boa constrictors are hunted for meat and sold in markets.

rg: Every continent except Antarctica, and most islands. Ireland, Iceland, Greenland and New Zealand have none.
df: Strictly carnivorous, swallowing prey whole: lizards, frogs, other snakes, small mammals, birds, eggs, fish and more.
fx: A few snakes, including the boa constrictor and green anaconda, nourish their young through a placenta, as mammals do.
